    2. Send it for a quote

    We reply with the delivered price, the options you chose and the delivery time. It is free and you do not have to buy.

    3. What happens next

    1. We check every item against the supplier listing: options, stock and the delivered price to your address.
    2. We email you one quote. Your products are inspected at our warehouse before dispatch, explained on How it works.
    3. You decide. Pay only if you accept the quote.

    Just buying one or two things? Use the Buy button on the product page instead. Your rights are in Legal.
